## Overview

This project outlines a practical structure for research analysis that keeps code, notes, figures, and written interpretation connected.

## Workflow

- Keep raw data separate from derived data.
- Write analysis scripts that can be rerun from a clean session.
- Use Quarto documents for interpretation, figures, and tables.
- Freeze expensive computations when publishing public outputs.

## Project Layout

The same directory structure is reused across projects so that a reader knows
where to look without being told:

- `data/raw/` — inputs exactly as received, never edited in place.
- `data/derived/` — everything a script can regenerate, safe to delete.
- `R/` or `src/` — analysis steps, each runnable from a clean session.
- `reports/` — Quarto documents that read derived data and produce the writing.

Anything under `data/derived/` and `reports/` is reproducible from the raw
inputs plus the code, which makes the boundary between input and output explicit.

## Status

This page describes the structure rather than a specific analysis. A public
example repository and a rendered sample report will be linked here once a
project using this layout is ready to share.
